meta.title: 3-Way Match (PO – Invoice – GRN): refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and determine whether 3-Way Match is refused or absent.
Use 3-Way Match to match a purchase order, invoice, and goods receipt.
Repeat the check as an AP Executive and verify the action is available.
